$comment: Ship kinds (CONTRACT §12): how a people leaves its ground. A ship kind is a recipe chain, not an unlock: a settlement can start one only when EVERY id in `knowledge` is in its library, the `pad` building stands complete in its lands, and the `hull` item (made by its own crafters from that recipe's inputs) and the `fuel` are in its store. class: 'air' (flies over its own world), 'orbit' (goes up and stays: sees every world of the sky), 'interplanetary' (crosses to another world), 'gate' (folds space: no hull, the gate building is the ship). crew [min, max] people aboard; cargo units of goods; prep hours of fuelling and loading at the pad; orbitHours hours circling before the transfer; days [min, max] game days of a crossing (by distance; air: per 1000 km of the world's own size scale); altitude m (air cruise, orbit height above the ground); reliability: chance a flight goes well with a skilled crew in calm skies; returns: the ship can carry fuel to fly home again (trade voyages).

ships.name: Airship
ships.desc: A gas bag over a steam engine: crosses seas and mountains of its own world.

ships.name: Orbiter
ships.desc: A machine set circling the world: every world of the sky seen clearly.

ships.name: Rocket
ships.desc: A crewed rocket: up through the sky, around the world, and across to another.

ships.name: Generation ship
ships.desc: A whole town in the sky: a people moves to another world, children born on the way.

ships.name: Gate crossing
ships.desc: Step through the ring and stand on another world.
